teachers.title: Robust Treatment of Collisions, Contact and Friction for Cloth Animation
facts: 把材料运动候选与碰撞处理分开，结合近接触响应和严格残余碰撞处理。
接触覆盖顶点—面及边—边；直接位置修正也可能产生相交。
preconditions: 防相交推导从无相交旧状态开始，约束旧状态到候选的运动。
costsAndLimits: 需要运动状态、空间检索、响应与重检；不是末帧检测器。
此次未核验可直接用于网页的作者软件包或其许可；论文不等于软件授权。
teachers.inferenceForR02: 可借模块分工；接缝和整理阶段的位移同样需要保护。尚未证明R02初态满足前提。
relevantSections: 4 Limiting the Strain and Strain Rate

teachers.title: Dynamic Deformables: Implementation and Production Practicalities (Now With Code!)
facts: CCD响应可能引入新碰撞；课程说明增量重检及GIA辅助恢复。
GIA利用交线和网格连通性；较小区域假设有例外，非流形不支持。
preconditions: 交线不一定闭合；恢复方向需要额外信息，不能只看最近距离。
costsAndLimits: 预防与恢复需要协调；其制作目标优先稳定、速度和艺术控制，不是制衣物理精度认证。
未复制课程代码；未进行其代码或依赖许可审查。
teachers.inferenceForR02: 先区分初态纠缠与后来穿越；开口、裁片边界和缝合等价组需要单独验证。

teachers.title: Codimensional Incremental Potential Contact
facts: 接触、厚度与应变限制联合求解，Newton迭代中以CCD过滤位移。

costsAndLimits: 官方代码声明Apache-2.0；本地构建涉及Python/C++、pybind11、Boost、Eigen、GMP等，未完成依赖许可审查或网页移植。

recommendedExperiment.question: At which observed assembly or correction stage do intersections first appear?
recommendedExperiment.method: Replay exact retained material data; take read-only snapshots after initial placement and each sewing/refinement/closure stage; audit coordinates using that stage's actual seam-group mapping.
limits: The earliest failing sample is not an exact time of impact.
The same parameters in a different runtime do not establish identical material data.
Keep original physical gates and independent final audit; a corrective method cannot certify itself.
No-intersection alone establishes neither calibrated fabric, fit, dynamic wear, nor production readiness.
